summary: Iteration 43 (Orcamentos Fase 3) — full backend + frontend E2E pass. New upload-docx endpoint (+ placeholder normalization, multi-tenancy, size/extension rejection) validated with 7 new tests. Regression of Fases 1+2 (iter40 20/20 + iter42 9/9) still 100% green. Frontend: new-quote-from-ticket-btn in ticket header opens QuoteEditor with client pre-filled, Templates tab has Upload .docx + Novo Template, Quill editor active with toolbar, and save-and-send triggers QuoteAttachModal with the recently created quote auto-selected.
critical_code_review_comments: quotes_routes.py _normalize_docx_placeholders: token_map only maps accent-stripped uppercase forms; ACENTO in tokens like ENDEREÇO already normalized via unicodedata → OK. Small nit: the generic {X} → {{X}} regex could false-match JS/CSS braces inside mammoth output but rare.
upload-docx endpoint reads entire file into memory before size check — for a 10MB limit this is fine, but could bail faster if UploadFile size hint is available.

QuoteAttachModal auto-select via initialQuoteId depends on quotes list containing the just-created id; current flow worked in E2E (~3s wait). If server-side list is slow, add retry/reload after save in OrcamentosPage before opening the attach modal.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend test_incinera.docx at /tmp/test_assets/test_incinera.docx (downloaded from customer-assets). Env var REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported when invoking pytest outside supervisor (already set in frontend/.env). Phase 3 closed.
